_comment: Config for the markdown-link-check CI gate (docs link-checker, #135). Scope is root *.md + docs/**. External http(s) URLs ARE checked: the repository has been public since 2026-07-22 (#697), so canonical github.com/nightgauge/* URLs resolve to an unauthenticated checker like any other public repo. Image assets are skipped: this gate validates cross-document reference integrity, not binary asset presence, and some operator-runbook screenshots are committed in follow-up PRs (see docs/images/*/README.md). Pure in-page #anchors are not resolved as files. aliveStatusCodes covers common bot-walling on third-party doc sites (401/403/429 from a WAF or rate limiter, 307 from a Next.js prefetch redirect with no Location header) -- a live site answering oddly to a headless checker is not a dead link.
